description: Pinned at zoom 5.5, inside the animated globe<->mercator projection morph (GLOBE_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_MIN=5..MAX=6). Checks that SymbolBucket#addToPlacement blends the globe-ECEF anchor toward its mercator-projected position (mirroring CollisionIndex#placeCollisionBox) instead of using the raw globe position, which would visibly offset the symbol mid-transition.
